questions.prompt: Why are they having difficulty arranging a site for the conference?

choiceTexts.A: It's a busy time of year.

questions.prompt: When will the conference take place?

choiceTexts.A: At the end of this month.
choiceTexts.C: At the end of this year.

questions.prompt: How many people do they expect at the conference?
What is the topic of the talk?
How should attendees request a special interpreter?

choiceTexts.A: By asking for one at the time of registration.
choiceTexts.B: By getting in touch with the head of the facility.
choiceTexts.C: By registering ahead of the other attendees.
choiceTexts.D: By requesting one when they arrive at a session.
